title: Portrait photograph of James R. Killian, Jr., Chapter 1 p. 27
description: Black-and-white head-and-shoulders portrait of a man in a suit, captioned "James R. Killian, Jr." It accompanies text on President Eisenhower authorizing Killian to lead the Technological Capabilities Panel in 1954 and the section "Project Three Support for the Lockheed CL-282."
